metadata.title: Spectral almost rigidity on Kähler manifolds with positive Ricci lower bound
metadata.abstract: In this work, a sharp Kähler spectral almost-rigidity theorem was established, resolving Conjecture 1.8 of Chu--Wang--Zhang. For compact Kähler manifolds satisfying $\Ric(\omega)\geq\omega$, pinching the first $n^2+3$ nonzero complex eigenvalues to one forces the manifolds to be Gromov Hausdorff close to normalized complex projective space and determines the biholomorphism type. The smaller index $n^2+1$ is the sharp threshold for noncollapsing. More generally, if a normalized measured limit has essential real dimension $r$, then the multiplicity of the critical eigenvalue is at most $r+\lfloor r/2\rfloor^2$, with equality attained in every dimension. A uniform energy estimate for kernel projections of complex gradient Gram matrices leads to a Lie algebra action on the whole spectral resolution.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 作者声称解决 Chu–Wang–Zhang 的谱几乎刚性猜想：Ric≥ω 时前 n²+3 个非零复特征值趋近一，迫使空间接近标准复射影空间并确定双全纯类型。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出 n²+1 的不塌缩锐阈值及极限维数与临界特征值重数的最优关系。
analysis.limitations: 须核对复 Laplacian 归一化、夹逼参数依赖及本质维数定义；不同阈值承担不同结论。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 与 Ricci 下界、谱几何和奇异极限高度相关，是本组核心审读条目。
